none: PAS CAM-C77346: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Arcadius, AD 388-408
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICTORIA AVGGG] ; D/ DN ARCAD[IVS P F AVG]

A copper-alloy nummus of Arcadius, AD 388-408 (Reece period 21). Reverse legend reads [VICTORIA AVGGG]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is Arles, AD 388-395. See LRBC p.57, no.566 or 569. Obverse legend reads DN ARCAD[IVS P F AVG]. Obverse shows a diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TCON. Die axis is 6 o'clock.
